content.title: Chapter 46 - HOUSING — Sec. 46-56. - Zoning and building laws.
content.summary:
All projects of the authority are subject to the planning, zoning, sanitary and building
               laws, ordinances and regulations applicable to the locality in which the project is
               situated.
(Code 1981, § 14-25; Ord. No. 1248, § 11, 6-16-1975)
